description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for testing the EmailConfigurationAPI in the OrangeHRM system. It contains test methods for retrieving, updating, and deleting email configuration settings via the API, utilizing mock services and test case data providers.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmailConfigurationAPI endpoints including get, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, truncates EmailConfiguration table, and loads fixture data.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single email configuration via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test case data for the getOne API test.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating email configuration via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test case data for the update API test.

methods.name: testUpdateWithEmptyConfiguration
methods.description: Tests updating with an empty configuration, ensuring edge case handling.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdateWithEmptyConfiguration
methods.description: Provides test case data for update tests with empty configuration.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that delete operation raises 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures that validation rule for delete also raises 'not implemented' exception.
